name: elder_wraith
description: old ghostly wanderer, pale sky-blue, hood hides the face, long beard, torn cloak, bare hovering feet, holds a long crooked staff with a glass lantern of tiny ghost faces

settings.style: Serious dark fantasy chunky pixel art, hard pixels, 1-px dark outline, flat 3-4 tones, deep fold shadows, no anti-aliasing, no gradients. Pale sky-blue translucent-looking spirit, muted palette, readable against a dark night graveyard. Side view facing right, hovering, no footsteps.

animations.name: idle
animations.notes: subtle breathing loop, feet stay planted

animations.name: walk
animations.notes: smooth looping glide forward, body bobs, cloth strips ripple back

frames.pose: windup: leans back, staff raised behind the shoulder, lantern pulled back
windup: lantern swings back and starts to glow
windup: peak, staff high, lantern glowing brightest
strike: staff swings forward and down, lantern whips ahead
strike: staff stretched forward at the farthest point
recovery: staff comes back, glow fades
hit: body jerks back, hood thrown back
windup: staff drawn back low, lantern glows
sweep: lantern flies in an arc, brightest
windup: rises, staff lifted straight up, lantern glows
peak: full blaze, cloak flung wide

animations.name: death
animations.notes: death animation, ends lying on the ground

frames.pose: folds to the ground, lantern drops
